question: India shares its land borders with ________ countries.
solution:
The correct answer is __**seven**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• India shares its land borders with **seven countries**.
 
• The countries are **Pakistan, China, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, Myanmar, and Afghanistan**.
 
• These borders span from the north-western region to the north-eastern region of India.
 
• Each of these borders has its own strategic, economic, and cultural significance.
